r_tuning.note: rebuilt from 4 shard dumps of a completed sweep; r read back from the cells, not re-tuned

protocol.note: baselines spend the identical TOTAL budget in one stage; IHC-FM stages it 300/300/200 because it has a hierarchy to stage

coupling.label: sinkhorn_uot (a project LABEL, not a coupling= string)

meta.parameter_matching_note: target is IHC-FM's ACTUAL allocated parameter count at this (d, k, r, hidden), counting decoder, ambient metric, saturator, dose and hierarchy; each neural baseline's width is solved to it
meta.power_design: k raised from 4 to 7 to buy folds: a LOCO fold holds out one intervention pair, so folds = k(k-1)/2 = 21 here against 6 at k=4. _run_stage samples one population per step, so training cost per fold does not grow with k. This is a 3.5x power improvement, NOT the 270-450 folds the measured neural-row effect size needs.
meta.seed_asymmetry: the four controls are deterministic given the benchmark (measured across-seed std: NoChange/PerturbedMean bitwise 0.0, MatchingMean 1.11e-16, LinearResponse 1.20e-10) while every neural arm carries 0.27-0.37; a single-fold table flatters whichever neural arm drew well, which is why no cell here is a single fold
meta.metric_policy: rank and select on normalised ED with its denominator reported; CFM loss is NEVER a ranking key (it tracks the coupling's identity-pair fraction: paired 1.0, ot 0.795, sinkhorn 0.229, independent 0.0039)

no_change.across_seed_sd_note: SD (ddof=1) of the per-seed means within one fold, median over folds. A SD, not a sem.
no_change.parameter_count_note: n_parameters counts trainable torch parameters; the closed-form controls have none but may still fit array state (n_fitted_array_entries), e.g. LinearResponse's ridge coefficient matrix

headline.statement: UNDERPOWERED FOR A HEADLINE CLAIM. The paired CI excludes zero, but the margin over FactoredAdditiveCFM is +0.135 normalised ED, below the 0.25 threshold the power analysis requires. Report as a small, precisely bounded difference, NOT as a win.

ablation_main_only_vs_full.power_note: WITHIN-MODEL and therefore the better-powered comparison: both arms share the fold, the seed, the initialisation, the benchmark draw and the full three-stage schedule, so fold difficulty and seed luck cancel in the paired difference. The cross-model rows do not enjoy this cancellation.
ablation_main_only_vs_full.architecture_note: the ablation disables the interaction PATHWAY only: same architecture, same parameter allocation, same step budget, same stages. It is an ablation arm, never a simplification of the main model.

oracle_context.verdict: OPEN NEGATIVE: the benchmark contains interaction signal worth 0.292 nED, but the interaction branch captures none of it (paired effect +0.015 nED, CI [-0.024, +0.051], includes zero). Both IHC-FM arms (0.640 and 0.625) remain ABOVE the interaction-free oracle (0.310), i.e. neither has reached the ceiling that main effects alone could deliver, so the interaction hierarchy has no headroom in which to show value on this benchmark. This is diagnosed, not fixed: the architecture is unchanged and the negative is reported.

table.unit_definition: the independent unit is the FOLD (one held-out intervention pair); seeds and the two taus are nested within it, so the bootstrap resamples folds and never rows
table.letter_display_note: letters are assigned by chaining ADJACENT paired tests: arms sharing a letter were not separated by the adjacent test. This is the standard compact display and is NOT a fully corrected all-pairs procedure; the pairwise tests are all in `contrasts` and `adjacent_separation`.
table.ranking_key: mean normalised energy distance over folds (lower is better)
table.cfm_loss_policy: CFM loss is NOT reported as a ranking key anywhere in this table: it tracks the identity-pair fraction of the coupling, not predictive quality

oracle.population_scope: order-2 populations only, matching the folds exactly (a LOCO fold holds out one intervention PAIR at both taus)

definitions.oracle_full: true field integrated on the same pre cells; shares the target's sampling noise exactly as a model prediction does, so this is the achievable floor
definitions.oracle_additive: true field with the interaction term removed, same integration
definitions.interaction_worth: oracle_additive - oracle_full: a hard CEILING on what any interaction mechanism can win on these populations

oracle.interpretation: a null interaction ablation is only informative when interaction_worth is materially above zero; compare the measured ablation effect against this ceiling before concluding anything about the mechanism

real_data.note: read back from results/loco_screen.json and results/finance_blocked.json; NOT re-derived here

organoid.honest_negative: IHC-FM beats the additive baseline over 136 paired populations but LOSES to no-change on the mean, which is dragged by a minority of large failures (sign test 72/136, p=0.549). Both directions are reported.

rank_report.note: pair basis rank saturates at min(r, k(k-1)/2); r below that aliases some pairs onto a shared interaction direction. Reported for interpretation -- r is selected by held-out score, since the measured recovery trend does not follow this bound.

rank_tuning.validation_basis: held-out records, SINGLETONS ONLY (every combination is screened, so including one would leak the screen's test data)

shift_diagnosis.rule: SHIFT: oracles differ (paired CI excludes 0 and ratio>1.5) AND measured shift ratio>3x within-train baseline. FAILURE: oracles agree but the fitted model is worse than transferred. UNINFORMATIVE: in-split oracle normED>=1.

previous_invalid_split.note: measured on the exposure axis under a split that allowed window overlap; recomputed here under the purged split. Not comparable to the chronological or held-out-day splits, which have no corresponding prior number.
